item.text: I’m locating the cover-page share count in the reconstructed filing JSON and will extract the shortest document-backed value.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import json
p='/mnt/data/LSF/data/financebench/processing/ACTIVISIONBLIZZARD_2020_10K_reconstructed.json'
with open(p) as f:
    data=json.load(f)
print(type(data))
print(data.keys() if isinstance(data,dict) else len(data))
PY"
